featured_reviews.name: Craig Saliyan
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you love ice-cream , then The Icecream Bakery (TIB) is your dream  destination . they have many outlets I visited this one in Mulund. the ambience is quite elegant. TIB makes their own ice-cream. They do not use any kind of artificial flavours. The ice cream that you order is prepared in front of you . It's really a pleasant experience to eat ice cream over here and it must be tried. TIB has a plethora of options to soothen your soul . Unique flavours , ice cream shooters, ice cream cakes , milkshakes , sundaes , you name it they have it all . I tried the following :
-> Rose Gulkand icecream: Gulkand for those who don't know is a mixture of rose petals and sugar. It tastes wonderful. This ice cream was simply lipsmacking . It's a part of the "Royal Indian Flavours" . The flavour of the gulkand  was clearly evident . Also since they prepare the ice cream right in front of you , you can see them adding the gulkand . The flavour of rose seemed extremely natural and fresh. Do give it a shot if you love gulkand .
-> Newyorkers: This is a part of their "TIB Mashups" . So what exactly is a mashup you may ask . It is basically cakes mashed up with their ice cream base. Newyorkers is a cheesecake mashup. This ice cream is straight up heavenly. The combination of the cheesecake and the ice- cream is a match made in heaven. Comin to TIB and not trying this ice cream would be a sin.
-> Mocha-Mocha Shooter : A shooter is a multilayered ice-cream mousse. It consists of layers brownie crumbs , semi-solid chocolate and coffee ice cream. Topped with a layer a whipped cream the mocha-mocha shooter is perfection. The flavours of the chocolate , brownie crumbs, coffee icecream  binds really well . The flavours are really well balanced.
-> Dark Night Sundae : first of all this dish had a presentation that was just next level awesome . The taste is a heavenly ride. The dark chocolate was well combined with the other elements of this dish .

At TIB you don't just eat your ice cream , you see it being prepared in front of you which in my opinion just sweetens the experience.

featured_reviews.name: Yashvi Gavankar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We visited Creamchills last Saturday. The place offers a wide variety of desserts and drinks, including mastani, falooda, ice creams, family packs, chocolate on fire, kulfi, and juices, and they even provide home delivery. There is also a sitting area upstairs, which makes it convenient for families and groups to enjoy their treats comfortably.

We ordered a mango mastani (₹155), a strawberry mastani (₹155), and a Belgian chocolate scoop (₹70). The total bill came to ₹380, which felt reasonable for the quality. The mastani was delicious, and the ice cream had a texture and flavour similar to gelato, which I really enjoyed. The staff was friendly and helpful, and I appreciated that they spoke Marathi, which made the interaction feel warm and welcoming.

The only drawback is that they currently do not offer Gadbad Falooda, a popular choice at many dessert shops. Adding it to the menu would make the variety even better.

Overall, Creamchills is a delightful spot for mastani and ice creams, with a wide range of options, a comfortable sitting area upstairs, and genuinely helpful staff. The flavours were rich, the service was good, and the atmosphere felt inviting. I would definitely recommend visiting this place for a sweet treat.
